title: Peruvian Beef Anticuchos
description: Grilled beef skewers, marinated in a zesty Peruvian sauce, served as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the chili peppers, garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Heat the oil in a small saucepan over low heat. Add the blended mixture and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Thread 4-6 pieces of beef onto each skewer.
Brush the skewers with the marinade, making sure they are evenly coated.
Grill the skewers over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the anticuchos hot, garnished with additional chili peppers if desired.
